caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which is a dress rendered in shades of light beige and brown. The dress features short, puffed sleeves that are gathered at the edges and a square neckline trimmed with a row of small, white embellishments. The bodice is moderately fitted, and the skirt is long and gently flared, falling smoothly to the floor. The lower edge of the dress has a border decorated with a repeating pattern of overlapping swags in a slightly darker beige, and from each swag hangs a white teardrop-shaped ornament. An additional long, sheer beige overlay is draped from the waist at the right side, reaching the ground and pooling slightly. The drawing is centered on the page and set against a plain, light background.
title: Wedding Dress
